title: Glowing red apple
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8a8a'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#e83030'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b81c2e'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='halo' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6060' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff6060' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow halo -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='44' ry='40' fill='url(#halo)'/>

  <!-- apple body -->
  <path d='M50 26 C34 22 18 32 18 50 C18 70 32 84 50 84 C68 84 82 70 82 50 C82 32 66 22 50 26 Z' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- shading on lower left -->
  <path d='M50 26 C34 22 18 32 18 50 C18 66 28 79 42 83 C30 76 26 64 28 52 C30 38 40 28 50 26 Z' fill='#c41e30' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- lighter rim highlight on right -->
  <path d='M50 26 C66 22 82 32 82 50 C82 62 77 73 68 80 C76 70 79 58 77 48 C75 36 64 28 52 27 Z' fill='#ff9d9d' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- bright specular highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='42' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#ffd6d6' opacity='0.75' transform='rotate(-25 38 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='38' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#ffb3b3' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- fruit stem -->
  <path d='M52 27 C52 20 54 14 58 10' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M57 18 C64 12 76 13 78 20 C71 26 60 25 57 18 Z' fill='#4fc24f'/>
  <path d='M60 19 C66 16 72 16 76 19 C71 22 63 22 60 19 Z' fill='#8fe88f' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- bottom shine -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='12' ry='4' fill='#ff9d9d' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
